findings.summary: The provider-free pytest wrapper removes LOCALAPPDATA, while the candidate cache locator required it and therefore failed seven current tests in the isolated review environment.
findings.correction: Resolve the exact local cache from LOCALAPPDATA when present or from the first existing non-symlink AppData/Local/npm-cache under the repository ownership ancestry; add positive stripped-environment and negative no-candidate tests.

findings.summary: The first manifest included a predecessor evidence test whose final assertion requires physical user-owned untracked docs/branding, which Git correctly does not copy into an isolated verifier worktree.
findings.correction: Do not alter the accepted predecessor test. Remove that non-transferable file from the corrected isolated-worktree manifest; retain direct exact digest and failed-result validation of both predecessor attempts in the current candidate and keep the main worktree preservation check.
